opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants for the Conference Attendance Award must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications should be physiological in nature.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or to finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should demonstrate how this fund would enhance their commitment to physiology and benefit the wider community of physiologists.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require an additional support to help them achieve their full potential.
